senses.zh: 不可否认的；无可争辩的
senses.en: definitely true or certain
examples: The link between poverty and bad health is [[undeniable]].

senses.en: ordinary and not interesting or exciting
examples: The [[mundane]] task of setting the table can be fun on holidays.

senses.zh: 全神贯注的；专心致志的
senses.en: (written) so interested in sth. that you do not notice anything else
examples: She listened to the speaker with [[rapt]] attention.

senses.zh: （尤指对他人的行为）感到惊讶；钦佩；赞美
senses.en: feel or express great surprise or admiration at sth., esp. sb.'s behavior
examples: I [[marvel]] at my mother's ability to remain calm in crisis.

senses.zh: 使暴露（于险境）；使置身（于危险）当中
senses.en: put sb. in a situation where they are not protected from sth. dangerous or unpleasant
examples: The report revealed that workers had been [[exposed]] to high levels of radiation.

senses.zh: 显露；露出（通常掩盖或隐藏的东西）
senses.en: show sth. that is usu. covered or hidden
examples: He lifted his T-shirt to [[expose]] a scar across his chest.

senses.en: not protected from attack
examples: These developments leave the company in an [[exposed]] position.

senses.en: not protected from the weather
examples: This side of the garden is [[exposed]] to wind.

senses.en: any of the long threads that carry messages between the brain and parts of the body, enabling you to move, feel pain, etc.
examples: She was diagnosed with a rare condition which affected the [[nerves]] in her back.

senses.en: (~s) feelings of worry or anxiety
examples: Sean drank a large glass of brandy to calm his [[nerves]].

senses.en: the state of being human rather than an animal or machine
examples: When we're in touch with our common [[humanity]], we remember that feelings of disappointment are universal.

senses.en: people in general
examples: We want a clean environment for all [[humanity]].

senses.en: (~ with / between / among) the activity of talking to other people, working together with them, etc.
examples: The researchers watch through a two-way mirror the [[interaction]] between mother and child in a small room.

senses.en: a process by which two or more things affect each other
examples: Price is determined through the [[interaction]] of demand and supply.

senses.en: lacking any human qualities in a way that seems strange or frightening
examples: I quit this [[inhuman]] job. I don't want to work for a machine.

senses.en: very cruel or without any normal feelings of pity
examples: The prisoners had suffered [[inhuman]] treatment.

senses.en: make sb. feel that they cannot think clearly or do not understand
examples: I understand the text but the diagrams are [[confusing]] me.

senses.zh: 令人困惑的；模糊不清的；难懂的
senses.en: unclear and difficult to understand
examples: The road signs were very [[confusing]] and we ended up getting lost.

senses.en: in a way that appears to have a particular quality when this may or may not be true
examples: The new minister was faced with a [[seemingly]] impossible task.

senses.zh: （想法、信仰、观点等）冲突的，矛盾的
senses.en: conflicting ideas, beliefs, opinions, etc. cannot exist together or both be true
examples: It can be difficult to balance the [[conflicting]] demands for our time.

senses.en: express annoyance or disappointment about sth. that you think is unsatisfactory or unfair
examples: He [[lamented]] that people had expected too much of him.

senses.en: express feelings of great sadness about sth.
examples: The nation [[lamented]] the death of its great leader.

senses.zh: 似乎无处不在的（有时为幽默手法）
senses.en: (fml.) seeming to be everywhere — sometimes used humorously
examples: He is as recognizable and as [[ubiquitous]] as the celebrities he photographs.

senses.en: very modern
examples: Modern armies consist of fewer soldiers and more [[advanced]] weapon systems.

senses.zh: 引起某人想象；吸引某人注意等
senses.en: (~ sb's imagination / attention, etc.) make sb. feel very interested in sth.
examples: His stories of foreign adventure [[captured]] my imagination.

senses.en: catch a person and keep them as a prisoner
examples: Government troops have succeeded in [[capturing]] the rebel leader.

senses.en: a group of people or things that are all of the same type
examples: Seats are available in ten price [[categories]].

senses.en: (BrE categorise) put people or things into groups according to the type of person or thing they are
examples: The population is [[categorized]] according to age, sex, and social group.

senses.en: a particular way of thinking about a problem or subject
examples: From a practical [[viewpoint]], I'd advise you not to go.

senses.en: give sb. the information and skills that they need to do sth.
examples: We [[equip]] students with the skills they will need once they leave college.

senses.en: provide a person or place with the things that are needed for a particular kind of activity or work
examples: They spent a lot of money [[equipping]] the school with new computers.

senses.en: sth. that you notice when watching sb. / sth.
examples: Some interesting [[observations]] emerged from this research.

senses.en: the process of watching sb. / sth. carefully for a period of time
examples: Most information was collected by direct [[observation]] of the animals' behavior.

senses.zh: 动态；（事物或人）相互作用的方式
senses.en: (~s) the way in which things or people behave, react, and affect each other
examples: He did research on group [[dynamics]] and leadership styles.

senses.zh: 不断移动的；不断变化的；动态的
senses.en: continuously moving or changing
examples: These countries are characterized by highly [[dynamic]] economies.

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；有创新思想的；志在成功的
senses.en: full of energy and new ideas, and determined to succeed
examples: We're looking for someone positive and [[dynamic]].

senses.zh: 揭露真相的；揭示内情的
senses.en: a remark or event that is revealing shows you sth. interesting or surprising about a situation or sb.'s character
examples: The document provided a [[revealing]] insight into the way government works.

senses.en: (only before noun) happening sometimes but not often or regularly
examples: He spent five years in Paris, with [[occasional]] visits to Italy.

senses.en: if two things intertwine, or if they are intertwined, they are twisted together
examples: He told us a story in which the present and the past [[intertwined]].

senses.en: if two situations, ideas, etc. are intertwined, they are closely related to each other
examples: Her fate [[intertwined]] with his.

senses.en: without a pause or interruption
examples: He has lived and worked in France almost [[continuously]] since 1990.

senses.zh: 全新地拟定（或表达）（话语、概念或计划）
senses.en: frame or express (words, or a concept or plan) differently
examples: She is trying to [[re-frame]] the debate about the care of children in need.

senses.en: (BrE mobile phone)
deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behavior
examples: Her teachers consider her a [[rebellious]], trouble-making girl.

senses.en: not considered to be modern or fashionable anymore
examples: His idea is regarded as rather [[old-fashioned]].

senses.en: (infml.) completely stupid or crazy, often in a way that is dangerous
examples: For some [[insane]] reason he decided to do the whole journey in one day.

senses.en: (only before noun) used to talk about the total amount of sth. that is received, paid, measured, or calculated in a month
examples: Summers are hot here, with [[monthly]] average temperature above 30 °C.

senses.en: if there is a possibility that sth. is true or that sth. will happen, it might be true or it might happen
examples: There is always a [[possibility]] that he might go back to Seattle.

senses.en: the act of making a computer, machine, or piece of software better and able to do more things
examples: The [[upgrade]] to the latest version costs $395.

senses.en: the process that a mobile phone uses when it is in a different country or area from usual, and has to connect to a different network

senses.zh: 传输，发送，传送（电子信号、信息等）
senses.en: send out electronic signals, messages, etc. using radio, television, or other similar equipment
examples: The system [[transmits]] information over digital phone lines.

senses.en: a gas or other substance that is sent into the air
examples: The government has decided to clean up industrial [[emissions]].

senses.en: a place where waste is buried under the ground

senses.zh: 废弃物的填埋；填埋的废弃物
senses.en: the practice of burying waste under the ground, or the waste buried in this way

senses.zh: 有毒的；由有毒物质引起的
senses.en: containing poison, or caused by poisonous substances
examples: [[Toxic]] chemicals have been spilled into the river for the past three months.

senses.en: an action, event, etc. that is decisive has a big effect on the way that sth. develops
examples: It is the chief executive's opinion that is ultimately [[decisive]].

senses.en: at a time that is not fixed
examples: They should arrive [[anytime]] between noon and 3 p.m.

senses.en: free sb. from feelings or conditions that make their life unhappy or difficult
examples: Writing poetry [[liberated]] her from the routine of everyday life.

senses.zh: 难以抗拒的；令人不知所措的
senses.en: having such a great effect on you that you feel confused and do not know how to react
examples: She felt an [[overwhelming]] desire to tell someone about what had happened.

senses.en: sth. difficult or worrying that you are responsible for
examples: His family responsibilities have started to become a [[burden]].

senses.en: (~ to do sth.) a strong desire to have or do sth. even though you know you should not
examples: Resist the [[temptation]] to buy the item until you're certain you need it.

senses.en: when sb. / sth. is present in a particular place
examples: Your [[presence]] is requested at the club meeting on Friday.

senses.en: sb. who sees a crime, accident or other event and can describe what happened
examples: According to [[witnesses]], the thief escaped through the bedroom window.

senses.en: interrupt sb. or become involved in their private affairs, in an annoying and unwanted way
examples: Would I be [[intruding]] if I came with you?

senses.en: affecting sb's private life or interrupting them in an unwanted and annoying way
examples: Some residents of the island found the presence of the film crew too [[intrusive]].

senses.zh: （持续等待或长时间做某事的）耐心
senses.en: the ability to continue waiting or doing sth. for a long time without becoming angry or anxious
examples: Teaching children with special needs requires [[patience]] and understanding.

senses.en: the ability to understand other people's feelings and problems
examples: The nurse should try to develop [[empathy]] between herself and the patient.

senses.en: a feeling of liking or love and caring
examples: She looked back on those days with [[affection]].

senses.en: quiet serious thinking about sth.
examples: The monks spend an hour on [[contemplation]] each morning.

senses.zh: 极其重要的；必不可少的
senses.en: (~ for / to) extremely important and necessary
examples: It is becoming almost [[essential]] for students to learn a second language.

senses.en: if you fulfil a hope, wish, or aim, you achieve the thing that you hoped for, wished for, etc.
examples: Visiting Disneyland has [[fulfilled]] my boyhood dream.

senses.en: making you feel happy and satisfied because you are doing interesting, useful, or important things
examples: Each of these courses is academically challenging and personally [[fulfilling]].

senses.en: able to exist or be used together without causing problems
examples: Are measures to protect the environment [[compatible]] with economic growth?

senses.en: the feeling of being grateful
examples: I would like to express my [[gratitude]] to everyone for their hard work.

senses.zh: 希腊的；希腊人的；希腊语的
senses.en: relating to Greece, its people, or its language
expect that sth. will happen and be ready for it
examples: We need someone who can [[anticipate]] and respond to changes in the fashion industry.

senses.en: serious, important, or useful
examples: They want a chance to do [[meaningful]] work.

senses.en: having a meaning that is easy to understand and makes sense
examples: These statistics are not [[meaningful]] to anyone but a scientist.

senses.zh: 极感兴趣的；全神贯注的；专注的
senses.en: so interested or involved in sth. that you do not notice anything else
examples: Judith was totally [[absorbed]] in her book.

senses.en: the ability to control your mind and body in order to achieve sth. that you want to do
examples: It took all his [[willpower]] to remain calm.

senses.en: sb. who owns sth.
examples: The police have been unable to trace the [[owner]] of the vehicle.

senses.en: make it certain that sth. will happen
examples: The process of training does not automatically [[guarantee]] you a job.

senses.en: promise to do sth. or promise that sth. will happen
examples: I [[guarantee]] you will love this film.

senses.en: (bound, bound) tie sb. / sth. so that they cannot move or are held together firmly
examples: They [[bound]] the package with brightly colored ribbons.

senses.zh: （使两部分）系牢，扎牢，结牢，扣紧
senses.en: close or join together the two parts of sth; become closed or joined together
examples: I was so fat that my skirt wouldn't [[fasten]].

senses.en: (not before noun) an experience, situation, etc. that is unreal seems so strange that you think you must be imagining it
examples: It seemed [[unreal]] to be talking to someone so famous.

senses.zh: 脱离现实的；不切实际的
senses.en: not related to real things that happen
examples: Many people have [[unreal]] expectations of what marriage will be like.

senses.en: if you disconnect or become disconnected from your feelings, family, society, etc., you no longer feel you belong or have a relationship with them
examples: Divorced men can too easily become [[disconnected]] from their children.

senses.zh: 切断（机器或设备）的电力（煤气、水）等供应
senses.en: remove the supply of power, gas, water, etc. from a machine or piece of equipment
examples: You should pay attention to [[disconnecting]] the machine from the mains first.

senses.en: make sb. feel certain that sth. is true
examples: Her arguments didn't [[convince]] everyone, but changes were made.

senses.en: (not before noun) feeling certain that sth. is true
examples: I was [[convinced]] that we were doing the right thing.

senses.en: completely different in attitudes, opinions, etc.
examples: On the surface, they look the same. But in reality, they are [[worlds apart]].

senses.en: give or leave sth. to people who will live after you
examples: The ring was [[handed down]] to her from her grandmother.

english: hang on sb.'s every word / words

senses.zh: 倾听（注意）某人每一个字 / 说的话
senses.en: pay close attention to everything sb. is saying
examples: She was watching him, [[hanging on his every word]].

senses.en: want sth. very much, esp. when it seems unlikely to happen soon
examples: These were the words she had secretly [[longed to]] hear.

senses.zh: （尤指无心地）触到敏感话题，触到痛处
senses.en: mention sth. that makes sb. upset, angry, or embarrassed, esp. accidentally
examples: You [[touched a raw nerve]] when you mentioned his first wife.

senses.en: show the most typical qualities of sb. / sth., esp. in a few words
examples: For me, the novel [[summed up]] the major problems of human existence.

senses.zh: 拆分；把···分成若干部分（以方便做或理解）
senses.en: separate sth. into smaller parts so that it is easier to do or understand
examples: The question can be [[broken down]] into two parts.

senses.en: used when you want to give the main point of sth.
examples: His novels belong to a great but vanished age. They are, [[in short]], old-fashioned.

senses.zh: 与···建立密切关系；尽力理解
senses.en: become involved with and try to understand sb. / sth.
examples: Are you so tired that you don't have the energy to [[engage with]] your kids?

senses.zh: （医生、工程师等）待命，随叫随到
senses.en: if sb. such as a doctor or engineer is on call, they are ready to go and help whenever they are needed as part of their job
examples: Don't worry, there is a doctor [[on call]] 24 hours a day.

senses.en: show that sth. is true or exists
examples: The empty workshops [[bear witness]] to the industrial past.

english: on the contrary / quite the contrary

senses.en: used to add to a negative statement, to disagree with a negative statement by sb. else, or to answer no to a question
examples: It wasn't a good thing; [[on the contrary]] it was a huge mistake.

senses.zh: 《纽约客》（美国知识、文艺类综合杂志）
阿那克萨哥拉（古希腊哲学家）
皮尤调查（美国 Pew Research Center 开展的民意调查）
